from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUTPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "results"
DOCS = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06"


def junit(path):
    document = ET.parse(path)
    suites = document.findall(".//testsuite")
    skipped = Counter()
    failures = []
    selected = []
    for case in document.findall(".//testcase"):
        for skip in case.findall("skipped"):
            skipped[skip.get("message", "")] += 1
        for tag in ("failure", "error"):
            for problem in case.findall(tag):
                failures.append({"class": case.get("classname"), "name": case.get("name"),
                                 "kind": tag, "message": problem.get("message"), "trace": problem.text})
        if case.get("name") in ("test_cancellation_during_final_log_write_preserves_success_and_revises_history",
                                "test_independent_processes_merge_under_shared_history_lock"):
            selected.append({"class": case.get("classname"), "name": case.get("name"),
                             "seconds": float(case.get("time", "0")),
                             "passed": not any(case.findall(tag) for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped"))})
    counts = {key: sum(int(suite.get(key, "0")) for suite in suites)
              for key in ("tests", "failures", "errors", "skipped")}
    counts["passed"] = counts["tests"] - counts["failures"] - counts["errors"] - counts["skipped"]
    return {**counts, "seconds": sum(float(suite.get("time", "0")) for suite in suites),
            "skip_reasons": dict(skipped), "failures_detail": failures, "selected_tests": selected}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    evidence = json.loads((OUTPUT / "evidence.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert evidence.get("finished_at"), "Test runner has not finished"
    assert evidence["product_sources_unchanged"]
    assert evidence["head"] == evidence["head_after"]
    assert not evidence["environment_after"]["mismatches"]
    assert evidence["environment_start"]["installed_packages"] == evidence["environment_after"]["installed_packages"]
    comparison = json.loads((OUTPUT / "comparison/evidence.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    history = json.loads((OUTPUT / "history/results.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    totals = defaultdict(lambda: {"cases": 0, "completed_cases": 0, "planned_operations": 0,
                                  "successes": 0, "returned_errors": 0, "errors": Counter(),
                                  "missing_workers": 0, "watchdogs": 0, "stopped_workers": [],
                                  "metadata_unchanged_cases": 0, "content_unchanged_cases": 0})
    assert len(comparison) == 36
    for row in comparison:
        group = totals[(row["source"], row["condition"])]
        group["cases"] += 1
        group["completed_cases"] += int(row.get("protocol_completed", False))
        group["planned_operations"] += row["rounds_requested"] * 3
        group["successes"] += row["successes"]
        group["returned_errors"] += row["failure_count"]
        group["errors"].update(row["errors"])
        group["missing_workers"] += row["missing_workers"]
        group["watchdogs"] += int(row["watchdog"])
        group["stopped_workers"].extend(row["stopped_workers"])
        assert row["source_sha256"] == evidence["sources"][row["source"]]["lock_sha256"]
        assert all(worker["sha256"] == row["source_sha256"] for worker in row["workers"])
        assert all(Path(worker["module"]).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(evidence["sources"][row["source"]]["src"]).resolve())
                   for worker in row["workers"])
        if row["protocol_completed"]:
            assert row["successes"] + row["failure_count"] == row["rounds_requested"] * 3
            assert row["exitcodes"] == [0, 0, 0]
            if row["operation"] == "acquire":
                assert row["counter"] == row["successes"]
        if row["operation"] == "open_only":
            expected = b"\0" if row["condition"] == "stable-one" else b"existing bytes"
            contents = (Path(row["folder"]) / "stable.lock").read_bytes()
            row["content_after_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest()
            row["expected_content_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()
            row["content_matches_initial_recipe"] = contents == expected
            group["content_unchanged_cases"] += int(contents == expected)
            group["metadata_unchanged_cases"] += int(row["before"] == row["after"])
    assert len(history) == 20
    for row in history:
        pin = json.loads(row["log"].splitlines()[0])
        assert pin["sha256"] == evidence["sources"]["final"]["lock_sha256"]
        assert Path(pin["module"]).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(evidence["sources"]["final"]["src"]).resolve())
    evidence["comparison"] = comparison
    evidence["history"] = history
    evidence["junit"] = {name: junit(OUTPUT / (name + ".xml")) for name in ("lock-regression", "v3-coverage")}
    evidence["analysis"] = {
        "comparison_totals": [{"source": source, "condition": condition, **value,
                               "errors": dict(value["errors"])} for (source, condition), value in totals.items()],
        "history_successes": sum(row["exitcode"] == 0 and not row["watchdog"] for row in history),
        "history_watchdogs": sum(row["watchdog"] for row in history),
        "all_worker_source_pins_verified": True,
        "all_history_source_pins_verified": True,
        "installed_packages_unchanged": True,
    }
    reference_bytes = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "e7e45e0:src/image_downloader/storage/interprocess_lock.py"], cwd=ROOT)
    latest_bytes = (Path(evidence["sources"]["final"]["src"]) / "image_downloader/storage/interprocess_lock.py").read_bytes()
    evidence["implementation_comparison"] = {
        "reference_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "e7e45e0"], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip(),
        "reference_to_latest_diff": subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "e7e45e0..HEAD", "--", "src/image_downloader/storage/interprocess_lock.py"], cwd=ROOT).decode("utf-8"),
        "lock_ast_identical": ast.dump(ast.parse(reference_bytes)) == ast.dump(ast.parse(latest_bytes)),
        "investigation_branch_tree_matches_latest": subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "origin/codex/fix-qs-013-construction-cleanup..HEAD", "--stat"], cwd=ROOT).decode("utf-8") == "",
    }
    assert evidence["implementation_comparison"]["lock_ast_identical"]
    evidence["runner_script"] = {"path": str(Path(__file__).parent / "run.py"), "sha256": hashlib.sha256((Path(__file__).parent / "run.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                                 "source": (Path(__file__).parent / "run.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
    evidence["summary_script"] = {"sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                                  "source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
    destination = DOCS / "raw/workflow-history-latest-alternate-environment-evidence-2026-10-12.json"
    assert not destination.exists()
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"analysis": evidence["analysis"], "junit": evidence["junit"],
                      "sources_unchanged": evidence["product_sources_unchanged"]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
